mission: Continuously discover, normalize, execute, score, recover, and regress-test benchmarks across Buddy's learning and professional capability graph.
failure_policy: A failed benchmark is evidence and becomes a training/recovery candidate; it does not corrupt the benchmark registry or lower unrelated capabilities.
repository_policy: Analyze and modify only DreamCo-owned or explicitly authorized repositories. Read-only is the default; code changes require configured approval gates.
source_integrity: Create original benchmark tasks, rubrics, datasets, and observations from lawful source material rather than copying protected course or site content.
north_star: The scanner exists to make Buddy measurably better at real tasks, not merely better at passing any one source's exercises.
